resolutions.answer: The claim's truth turns on tokens containing both backslash and double-quote (class C4) and their multi-token adjacency effects (C5): detokenize quotes any token containing a double-quote and escapes only quotes, never backslashes, so a raw backslash inside the quoted emission is read by tokenize's in-quote escape rule and consumes the next emitted character (an escape backslash, a data character, or the closing quote). Tokens over {a,b} only (C1), quote-only tokens (C2), and backslash-only tokens (C3, emitted bare where backslash is literal) all round-trip safely. Full partition in analysis-classes.md.

VIOLATED. In-domain counterexample: the single-token list whose token is backslash followed by double-quote (JSON: ["\\\""], 1 token, 2 chars). detokenize emits the 5-character string quote backslash backslash quote quote; tokenize then opens the quoted region, the raw backslash escape-consumes the following backslash, the emitted escaped quote closes the region, the real closing quote reopens it, and end-of-input flushes cur, yielding the single-token list ["\\"] (one backslash) != input. Mechanical step-by-step trace in violation-trace.md.
